bp-energy-outlook-2015-002.note: Forecast verified: EO2015 table 2015 column (332.7 renewables + 62.8 biofuels) / 13265.8 = 2.98%, stored as 3.0. Actual 3.51 matches OWID/EI, but bp's own later-stated 2015 value on its 38%-efficiency basis is 3.34% (EO2017 table, (364.9+74.2)/13147.3) or 3.44% (EO2019 table), which gives error -0.36 to -0.46 pp (hit) instead of -0.51 (partial). The README's 'within 0.1 point' base-year check holds for EO2019 only; EO2015-2017 base years sit 0.15-0.18 pp below the EI series (2012: 2.36 vs 2.54; 2014: 3.00 vs 3.15; 2015: 3.34 vs 3.51), and this row is 0.01 pp from the threshold. bp summary tables (Wayback xlsx) re-parsed; EI series re-derived from OWID energy-data CSV (renewables_share_energy minus hydro_share_energy; OWID renewables include biofuels, matching bp's renewables incl. biofuels excl. hydro).
